text:
Alex: Heads-up — eu-west1 apiserver 5xx burst starting ~03:12 UTC after GPU pool scaled. controller-manager restarted a few pods; attach latency spiked. Anyone on-call?
Maria: seeing it too. SNAT port exhaustion on nat-gw-eu-west1 around same time. Match in k8s-proxy counters.
Devon: controller-manager logs show repeated lease renew failures, then OOMKill on one replica. suspect attach/detach delays causing backlog.
Tao: cost note: this pattern ramps Reserved GPU churn which will bump committed-util; we should consider temp throttle to reduce autoscale churn :thinking_face:
Alex: @sre-bot can you post metric snapshots for apiserver_5xx_rate, provisioner_attach_latency, and nat_conntrack_used?
sre-bot: Metric snapshot attached: apiserver_5xx_rate=0.72, provisioner_attach_latency_p50=1.8s p95=12.3s, nat_conntrack_used=98% :warning:
June: we saw a similar wave last month — root cause then was aggressive preemption + kube-proxy conntracking. Workaround was bumping SNAT pool and pausing fast autoscale.
Maria: quick query I ran:
```
rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]) by (code)
```
shows increased 500s from /apis/core/v1/namespaces endpoints.
Devon: controller-manager stacktrace snippet:
```
E0303 03:12:34.123 controller.go:245] unable to renew lease: post "/leases": dial tcp 10.0.0.1:6443: i/o timeout
```
Alex: action items: 1) Temporarily lock GPU autoscaler in eu-west1 to prevent new scale-ups (Devon). 2) Spin up temp SNAT nodes or increase ephemeral ports (Tao). 3) Restart controller-manager replica on different AZ after cordon (June). 4) Open billing watch — notify finance if committed-util jumps (Maria).
Devon: pausing autoscaler now — running `kubectl annotate ns/redwood autoscaler-lock=1 --overwrite`
June: restarting ctrlmgr on replica-2, tracking.
Tao: provisioning two extra NAT instances in eu-west1, ETA ~8m.
Maria: flagged a billing watch with finance@redwood and included estimated delta.
Alex: follow-up: we should add a preflight check to autoscaler to query nat_conntrack_free > 200 before scale. filing ticket.
Devon: created GH issue #5421 with repro notes and attaching logs.
sre-bot: Alert cleared: apiserver_5xx_rate back to 0.04 after interventions. Closing loop — remember to revert autoscaler-lock in 30m :white_check_mark:
Alex: good job team. postmortem pls with timeline and cost delta. :thumbsup:
